resolution: Built both layers of the 'mesh-editor primitive -> placeable custom piece' loop the user asked for (railings on stairs, walls with cut windows / bolted-on posters). Layer 1 seed-from-primitive: editors/model/seedFromPiece.ts lowers any BUILD_CATALOG piece (wall, window-wall already cut, floor, stairs, ramp-as-wedge) into one editable EditMesh via the SAME pieceVisualShapes decomposition the editor + compile bake share — 6/6 v8cli, committed 8addfde76. Layer 2 cook-as-real-piece: a cooked model carries an optional buildPlacement {snap,cover,blocksSight} so it edge/surface-snaps and grants cover while staying kind:'prop' (the engine treats every mesh-backed placeable as a prop and the validator forbids propKind on other kinds, so a literal kind:'railing' would have fought the grain across ~20 render/bake/collision branches; snap+cover deliver the piece BEHAVIOUR with none of that churn) — 3/3 v8cli; cookedAsset.ts plumbing + cookedPiece.test committed 950cdb0d1. The cook->catalog->editor-render->/compiled-bake path already existed for prop-kind assets, so this is the minimal durable bridge. BLOCKED/HANDOFF: the matching reads in game/kinds/props.ts (PropBuildPlacement type+field) and game/build/catalog.ts (propCatalogEntry) are implemented + GREEN but left uncommitted because both files are co-occupied by other live sessions' large uncommitted batches (props.ts +650 lines, currently failing its own shelf test; catalog.ts COOKED_CATALOG overlay) and cannot be isolated for a clean atomic commit without interactive staging. Remaining for the user-visible loop: two Studio.tsx UI hooks (a 'Start from piece' seed entry + a 'Build piece' placement picker in the Compile dialog) — Studio.tsx also co-occupied. Asked the user whether to hold until those sessions land or push into the co-occupied files now.
